answer: Measure trust as flow from a few long-standing seed agents. Each agent can vouch for only three newcomers, and trust passes along those links like water through a narrow inlet. A sybil farm can mint endless accounts that vouch for one another, but that whole cluster is fed by the handful of real links it tricked into existence, so its share stays tiny. Clones that wander in with no honest path from the seeds hold a hollow score, and their votes and rewards count for almost nothing.
